commands.review_summary:
The PR changes oversized installed-plugin file hashing from an unbounded whole-file synchronous read to a bounded 64 KiB synchronous read loop capped at 50 MiB, with a sparse-file regression test.

PR surface: Source +30, Tests +17. Total +47 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: create two regular files larger than 50 MiB with identical first 50 MiB and different trailing bytes; the proposed loop returns the same digest for both, while current main hashes their complete contents.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A narrow mechanical repair can restore full-file content hashing with bounded memory; contributor runtime proof remains a separate merge gate.

target.title: fix(plugins): bound safeHashFile in installed-plugin-index-hash with size cap
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`safeHashFile` in `src/plugins/installed-plugin-index-hash.ts` reads entire files synchronously with no size limit — despite being named "safe". Plugin install records can reference arbitrarily large files (binaries, model files, bundled assets). A multi-GB `readFileSync` would OOM the Node process before the `catch` block can run.

## Why This Change Was Made

A function named "safe" should not have unbounded sync reads. The existing `catch` block handles ENOENT and permission errors but cannot prevent OOM from multi-GB files.

## What Changed

Replaced the hard 50 MiB rejection (from the original PR draft) with **bounded-memory streaming SHA-256 hashing**:

- Files ≤ 50 MiB: read and hash in one call (unchanged behavior)
- Files > 50 MiB: streamed in 64 KiB chunks using `fs.openSync` + `fs.readSync`, stopping after 50 MiB. This preserves a content hash for existing large files while keeping memory usage bounded.

The `statSync` pre-check still validates regular files and rejects non-regular paths before any read.

## Evidence

**All 27 tests pass:**

[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.plugins.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.10 /home/0668000387/openclawCxbAsDev

 ✓ |plugins| src/plugins/installed-plugin-index.test.ts (27 tests) 1115ms
     ✓ drops blocked install record keys while reading persisted index records  426ms
     ✓ discovers installed plugin packages from persisted install records  389ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  27 passed (27)
   Start at  10:03:47
   Duration  6.31s (transform 4.47s, setup 1.49s, import 3.34s, tests 1.11s, environment 0ms)

## Changes

- `src/plugins/installed-plugin-index-hash.ts`: Replace hard size rejection with streaming SHA-256 via `fs.openSync`/`fs.readSync` in 64 KiB chunks
- `src/plugins/installed-plugin-index.test.ts`: Add regression test for streaming hash on files > 50 MiB
